title: Demystifying Manifold Constraints in LLM Pre-training
summary: The recent success of matrix optimizers (e.g., Muon) suggests that specific normalization of momentum, such as orthogonalization and row-wise normalization, benefits both the stability and acceleration of LLM training. Consequently, several recent studies have suggested that weights should also be normalized, leading to a Riemannian optimization problem. While such constrained training frameworks demonstrate superior performance, the effects of explicitly constraining weights, and their interaction with existing stabilization mechanisms, remain less understood.
